title: Roasted Cauliflower 'Steaks'
description: This roasted cauliflower steaks recipe turns a whole cauliflower head into vegetable "steaks" that present beautifully on a plate with your chosen side.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

Place cauliflower onto a cutting board with stem-side facing up; cut vertically into 4 evenly thick steaks. Arrange steaks onto the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle olive oil over steaks; season with garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, flip with a spatula, and continue to roast until soft in the middle and darkening around edges, about 15 minutes more.
